The idea

Numbers tell you how much.
Visual You shows you what it means.

Build beneficial habits, reduce unwanted behaviors, exercise, and stay consistent. Your virtual body and progress history evolve alongside you, making change easier to understand and more motivating to continue.

Good habitsUnwanted habitsWorkoutsPlansRewardsAI Coach
01

Your body, in progress

Organ coloring

Your organs change color with the habits you track. Positive choices improve their symbolic condition, while unwanted or missed habits may lower it—turning invisible patterns into something you can see.

iMotivational indicators only — never medical assessments or diagnoses.
02

Train with intention

Muscle progress

Arms, chest, shoulders, back, abs, and legs respond to your completed workouts. As you train consistently, each muscle group changes color so you can see where your effort is going.

iA clear visual map of the muscle groups receiving your attention.
03

Every day has a story

Calendars & streaks

A daily history colored from red to blue shows your overall performance at a glance. Open any day to see what you completed, missed, or planned, while overall and habit-specific streaks make consistency tangible.

iStreak Aids can protect your momentum after up to two missed days.
04

Change at a human pace

Plans that adapt

Gradual Reduction uses fast, medium, or easy schedules to increase the time between unwanted behaviors. Gradual Growth gently adds active days or repetitions and can move missed tasks to another eligible day.

iHeatmaps translate numerical records into a red-to-blue history of your progress.
05

Patterns, not guesswork

Graphs that explain

See how your habits change across daily, weekly, monthly, and yearly periods. Explore one habit, combine several into a Main Graph, or build Group Graphs for goals that belong together.

iFlexible tracking supports repetitions, time, amounts, and numerical goals.
06

Consistency deserves credit

Badges & tokens

Meaningful milestones earn badges and tokens. Use rewards to temporarily unlock selected premium features, obtain Streak Aids, and keep the journey motivating long after the first burst of energy.

iA reward system built around progress—not perfection.
07

Guidance when you need it

AI Coach

Ask about routines, progress, difficult patterns, or gradual-change plans. The AI Coach uses what you choose to share to offer practical strategies, fresh perspective, and encouragement along the way.

iAI guidance does not replace professional medical or psychological advice.
